notes: The second 'with' (t010) is rule 33's supplied word on the adverbial accusative מָגֵן, exactly as 'with buckler' in v. 4; אִתָּם already holds a 'with' of its own, and rule 33 says a preposition elsewhere in the clause does not silence it.
No copula is written anywhere in this verbless list, so rules 20 and 49 have nothing to place.
